votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of April 8, 2025 and May 6, 2025
votes.description: The Council approved the pending work session meeting minutes from April 8, 2025 and May 6, 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 30 declaring September 15, 2025 through October 15, 2025 as Hispanic Heritage Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing and honoring Hispanic Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and consider each item separately for Ordinance 54 of 2025, Budget Amendment #1 for FY 2025-26
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2025-26 and agreed to consider each budget amendment item separately.

votes.motion: Approve Item A-3 for Public Right-of-Way Safety barricades
votes.description: The Council approved budget amendment funding for public right-of-way safety barricades to allow safe pedestrian passage in front of buildings burned in the August 11, 2025 Main Street fire.

votes.motion: Approve Item A-1 for the Emergency Loan Program
votes.description: The Council approved budget amendment funding for an emergency loan fund program for businesses affected by the Main Street fire on August 11, 2025.

votes.motion: Defer Item A-4 for Rental Assistance
votes.description: The Council deferred action on the rental assistance budget amendment item to a future meeting pending additional information from the Administration.

votes.motion: Request additional information from the Administration on the programs, including criteria for financial assistance programs, requirements for Emergency Loan fund use, and considerations for higher boarded building fees within the CBD
votes.description: The Council directed the Administration to provide additional policy information regarding the financial assistance programs related to the Main Street fire, including criteria for deployment, loan fund requirements, and higher boarded building fees in the Central Business District.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 56 of 2025 for a Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 247 North 800 West
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending the zoning at approximately 247 North 800 West from R-1/7,000 and SR-3 to R-1/5,000 and SR-3 to enable additional residential development accessed from Hoyt Place.

votes.motion: Postpone action on the Zoning Text Amendment Public Lands (PL) and Street Vacation - West High School to a future Council Meeting
votes.description: The Council postponed action on the proposed zoning text amendment and street vacation ordinances related to the reconstruction of West High School at approximately 240 West 200 North.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 57 of 2025 for a Zoning Map Amendment / Development Agreement for the Delta Center Parking Garage at approximately 301 West South Temple
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving a Master Development Agreement for the construction of a seven-story parking garage with approximately 452 stalls at the Delta Center Arena site at 301 West South Temple.

The Council approved all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and resolutions, and approving board appointments and reappointments to the Arts Council and Parks, Natural Lands, Trails, and Urban Forestry Advisory Board.
